description: Questions about the person's own records (appointment, referral, document, message status, account). The chatbot isn't connected to the database, so these should reach the topic that tells them where to check. None are training patterns, but they were looked at while choosing phrasings. Scored with: python evaluate.py --test tests/records_set.json
